title: LLM-BASED BOT BROADENS THE RANGE OF ARGUMENTS IN ONLINE DISCUSSIONS, EVEN WHEN TRANSPARENTLY DISCLOSED AS AI
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of an LLM-based moderator on the diversity of arguments in online discussions. While it includes 'moral dilemmas' as one potential argument category in its list of discussion topics, the study focuses on the objective and subjective measurement of argument diversity and participation balance, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks.
